current_state_contract: Actual complete latest snapshot bytes/checksum/envelope under stable exclusive lock; atomic cooperating read/change/append; local observed sequence floor; no cache-supplied state.
accepted_history_contract: Strict startup once and explicit audit; historical fault detection deferred between audits. Default and non-work CLI remain strict.
rollback_limit: No durable global antirollback guarantee: unseen-commit rollback and fresh-process valid-prefix rollback remain outside the floor, as strict replay lacks such an anchor too.
performance_limit: Removes per-operation O(history) verification; exact29s live saving unmeasured.
